statement_zh: 意式浓缩放大醇厚度与油脂，前段高挥发花果香被压缩。
statement_en: Espresso amplifies body and oils; the volatile floral and fruit top notes are compressed.

statement_zh: 冷萃抑制低挥发酸，酸质与花香偏弱，甜感与醇厚更突出。
statement_en: Cold brew suppresses the low-volatility acids: less acidity and floral lift, more sweetness and body.

statement_zh: 手冲常见的表现是花香与果酸更清晰，醇厚较轻。
statement_en: Pour-over tends to show florals and fruit acidity more clearly, with a lighter body.
citation_ref: owner 2026-09-12; reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 浸泡式萃取带入更多油脂与细粉，醇厚度上升，干净度下降。
statement_en: Immersion brewing carries more oils and fines: more body, less clarity.

statement_zh: 浅烘保留更多绿原酸与高挥发香气，酸质与花果香突出。
statement_en: Light roasts keep more chlorogenic acids and volatile aromatics: acidity and floral-fruit notes lead.

statement_zh: 中浅烘保留花果酸质，同时开始形成焦糖化甜感。
statement_en: Medium-light roasts keep the floral-fruit acidity while caramelisation sweetness begins.

statement_zh: 中烘平衡酸质与美拉德产物，坚果与焦糖增强。
statement_en: Medium roasts balance acidity against Maillard products: nut and caramel rise.

statement_zh: 中深烘美拉德产物占比高，醇厚度、巧克力与苦感上升，酸质下降。
statement_en: Medium-dark roasts are Maillard-dominated: body, chocolate and bitterness rise, acidity falls.

statement_zh: 深烘绿原酸大量降解，焦糖苦与烟熏占主导。
statement_en: Dark roasts degrade most chlorogenic acids: caramelised bitterness and smoke dominate.

statement_zh: 极深烘以碳化与烟熏为主，品种与产地特征基本被覆盖。
statement_en: Very dark roasts are carbonised and smoky; origin and variety character is mostly covered.

statement_zh: 水洗去胶质快，内源有机酸突出：干净度高、柑橘、花香、高酸。
statement_en: Washed processing removes mucilage quickly; the bean's own organic acids stand out: clean, citrus, floral, high acidity.

statement_zh: 日晒让果肉糖分在发酵中渗入豆内，还原糖与游离氨基酸升高：果酱、热带水果、高甜。
statement_en: Natural processing lets fruit sugars ferment into the seed: more reducing sugars and free amino acids — jam, tropical fruit, high sweetness.
citation_ref: owner 2026-09-12; reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 厌氧发酵常带来更多乳酸与酯类风味：酸奶感与酒香。
statement_en: Anaerobic fermentation tends to add lactic and ester notes: yoghurt and winey character.
citation_ref: owner 2026-09-12; reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 蜜处理保留部分果胶发酵，甜感与醇厚介于水洗与日晒之间。
statement_en: Honey processing keeps part of the mucilage: sweetness and body between washed and natural.

statement_zh: 脱因工艺去除部分前体物质，香气强度整体下降。
statement_en: Decaffeination removes some precursors; aroma intensity drops overall.

statement_zh: 瑰夏常见茉莉、白花与柑橘酸质，醇厚偏轻。
statement_en: Gesha commonly shows jasmine, white florals and citrus acidity with a lighter body.
citation_ref: owner 2026-09-12; reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 波本甜感与平衡度好，焦糖与红果常见。
statement_en: Bourbon is sweet and balanced; caramel and red fruit are typical.

statement_zh: SL28/SL34 以黑加仑与明亮柑橘酸质著称。
statement_en: SL28/SL34 are known for blackcurrant and bright citric acidity.

statement_zh: 埃塞原生种以茉莉花、柑橘与蓝莓（日晒）为标志。
statement_en: Ethiopian landraces are marked by jasmine, citrus and, when natural, blueberry.

statement_zh: 铁皮卡干净、甜感柔和，醇厚适中。
statement_en: Typica is clean and gently sweet with moderate body.

statement_zh: 罗布斯塔前体糖分低、绿原酸与咖啡因高：苦感与醇厚重，花果弱。
statement_en: Robusta has low sugar precursors and high chlorogenic acid and caffeine: heavy bitterness and body, little floral-fruit.

statement_zh: 浅烘保留了更多绿原酸与挥发性花果香，手冲又让这些花香与果酸更清晰。
statement_en: Light roast keeps more chlorogenic acids and volatile floral-fruit aromatics, and pour-over lets those florals and acids read clearly.
citation_ref: owner 2026-09-12 (design examples); reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 中深烘的美拉德产物在意式高压下被油脂放大：黑巧、焦糖与厚重口感主导，酸质退到后段。
statement_en: Medium-dark Maillard products are amplified by espresso pressure and oils: dark chocolate, caramel and weight lead; acidity retreats.

statement_zh: 冷萃压低了浅烘的低挥发酸，花香减弱、甜感与茶感更清晰。
statement_en: Cold brew flattens the light roast's low-volatility acids: less floral lift, clearer sweetness and tea-like body.

statement_zh: 浅烘 + 水洗保留了柠檬酸与高极性酯类：柑橘、茉莉与干净的酸质。
statement_en: Light roast plus washed processing keeps citric acid and polar esters: citrus, jasmine and clean acidity.

statement_zh: 浅烘 + 日晒把发酵进豆内的果糖与酯类完整保留：蓝莓、果酱与高甜。
statement_en: Light roast plus natural processing keeps the fermented fruit sugars and esters: blueberry, jam and high sweetness.

statement_zh: 中深烘 + 厌氧常见的表现是黑巧与发酵感并存；若你尝到的酸质更高，与这个组合的常见表现不同。水温偏低是可能的原因之一，但仅凭描述无法确定。
statement_en: Medium-dark plus anaerobic usually reads as dark chocolate with fermentation; a brighter acidity differs from the usual pattern for this combination. A cool brew is one possible reason, but the description alone cannot tell.
citation_ref: owner 2026-09-12 (design examples); reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 极浅烘几乎不动豆子的原始结构：绿原酸与挥发性花果香保留最完整，酸质最突出，甜感与醇厚尚未展开。
statement_en: A very light roast barely touches the bean's original structure: chlorogenic acids and volatile florals stay almost intact, acidity is at its most pronounced, sweetness and body have not opened yet.
citation_ref: operator extension of the owner's light-roast statement, 2026-09-12; reworded OWNER_COPY_REVIEW_2026-09-12 (tendency wording, no genetic ceiling / no cause asserted from the description)

statement_zh: 粉床细粉迁移引发微观通道效应时，局部过萃会导致中段甜感中断，并在余韵中引入涩感与杂味。
statement_en: When fines migrate and open micro-channels in the bed, local over-extraction breaks the mid-palate sweetness and brings astringency and off-notes into the finish.
citation_ref: Coffee Ad Astra (Jonathan Gagné) — physics of coffee extraction — https://coffeeadastra.com/ ; The Physics of Filter Coffee, ISBN 978-0-578-95028-0

statement_zh: 浅烘手冲时，萃取率落在合适区间才有饱满的中段甜感；萃取率不足则酸而空，过高则涩。
statement_en: For light roasts on pour-over, mid-palate sweetness fills in only inside the right extraction-yield window; under-extraction reads sour and hollow, over-extraction astringent.
citation_ref: Coffee Ad Astra (Jonathan Gagné) — physics of coffee extraction — https://coffeeadastra.com/ ; The Physics of Filter Coffee, ISBN 978-0-578-95028-0

statement_zh: 中深烘意式在高压下通道效应更敏感：粉饼不均会同时出现欠萃的酸与过萃的苦。
statement_en: Medium-dark espresso is more sensitive to channeling under pressure: an uneven puck shows under-extracted sourness and over-extracted bitterness at once.
citation_ref: Coffee Ad Astra (Jonathan Gagné) — physics of coffee extraction — https://coffeeadastra.com/ ; The Physics of Filter Coffee, ISBN 978-0-578-95028-0

statement_zh: 快萃与较高水温优先溶解极性较高的有机酸分子，前段酸质与花果香先被释放。
statement_en: Fast extraction at higher water temperature dissolves the more polar organic acids first, so acidity and floral-fruit notes lead.
citation_ref: UC Davis Coffee Center — brewing kinetics and sensory maps — DOI: 10.1016/j.foodchem.2020.126567 (Cotter et al., 2020, Food Chemistry; reference paper supplied by the owner)

statement_zh: 研磨度过细会加速大分子绿原酸内酯的释放，从而增加尾段苦感；高压萃取同时带出更多油脂与醇厚度。
statement_en: Too fine a grind accelerates the release of large chlorogenic-acid lactones and adds late bitterness; pressure extraction also carries more oils and body.
citation_ref: UC Davis Coffee Center — brewing kinetics and sensory maps — DOI: 10.1016/j.foodchem.2020.126567 (Cotter et al., 2020, Food Chemistry; reference paper supplied by the owner)

statement_zh: 低温长时萃取下，挥发性酸与酸质通常更弱，感官图谱偏向甜感与圆润。
statement_en: Under long, cold extraction the volatile acids and acidity are usually weaker; the sensory map shifts toward sweetness and roundness.
citation_ref: UC Davis Coffee Center — brewing kinetics and sensory maps — DOI: 10.1016/j.foodchem.2020.126567 (Cotter et al., 2020, Food Chemistry; reference paper supplied by the owner)

statement_zh: 浸泡式萃取与金属滤网让更多细粉与油脂进入杯中，醇厚度上升、干净度下降。
statement_en: Immersion brewing through a metal filter passes more fines and oils: more body, less clarity.
citation_ref: UC Davis Coffee Center — brewing kinetics and sensory maps — DOI: 10.1016/j.foodchem.2020.126567 (Cotter et al., 2020, Food Chemistry; reference paper supplied by the owner)

statement_zh: 瑰夏（Gesha）基因决定了其高挥发性单萜烯（如芳樟醇）的高表达上限，浅烘焙下呈现高锐白花与单醇果酸。
statement_en: The Gesha genotype sets a high ceiling for volatile monoterpenes such as linalool; at light roast it reads as sharp white florals and clean, single-note fruit acidity.
citation_ref: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog — https://worldcoffeeresearch.org/resources/sensory-lexicon

statement_zh: 浅烘保留品种的花香与果酸参照物（花香、柑橘酸、单醇甜感），焦糖化产物尚未主导。
statement_en: Light roasting keeps the variety's floral and fruit-acid references (florals, citric acidity, clean sweetness) before caramelisation products take over.
citation_ref: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog — https://worldcoffeeresearch.org/resources/sensory-lexicon

statement_zh: 中烘时焦糖化与美拉德参照物（红糖、坚果、可可）与残余果酸达到平衡。
statement_en: At medium roast the caramelisation and Maillard references (brown sugar, nut, cocoa) balance the remaining fruit acidity.
citation_ref: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog — https://worldcoffeeresearch.org/resources/sensory-lexicon

statement_zh: 深烘下花香与果酸参照物被烘烤参照物（烟熏、焦糖苦、灰烬）覆盖。
statement_en: At dark roast the floral and fruit-acid references are covered by roast references (smoke, burnt caramel, ash).
citation_ref: World Coffee Research — Sensory Lexicon / Varieties Catalog — https://worldcoffeeresearch.org/resources/sensory-lexicon
